pulse.description: Gaussian bump (width 0.04) advected on [0, 1]; parameter: centre in [0.2, 0.8]

front.description: tanh front (thickness 0.01) on [0, 1]; parameter: position in [0.2, 0.8]

soliton.description: KdV one-soliton on [0, 20]; parameters: speed in [1, 4], position in [6, 14]

burgers.description: Cole-Hopf solution of viscous Burgers (nu = 0.02) on the periodic unit interval; parameters: eps in [0.90, 0.995], shift in [-0.25, 0.25]
